title: Exact Integration and Invertibility Completeness of the Nonlinear Relaxation Equation
summary: We examine the nonlinear initial value problem $\dot{y} = C(1 - y^α)$ modeling polytropic gas permeation. For rational $α$, we derive the exact primitive via cyclotomic partial fraction decomposition, establishing its real trigonometric representation. By synthesizing Ritt's theorem with Rosenlicht's differential algebraic residue criterion, we prove the exact step response $y(t)$ is an elementary function if and only if $α\in \{1, 2\}$.
